<thought>To locate the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using the correct functional group names from the available list. The forward Peterson elimination breaks a ketone and a trimethylsilyl group and forms a C‑C double bond. Therefore, I will query for templates that break “ketones” and “trimethylsilyl” and form “C‑C double bonds”, also specifying the relevant bond changes.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "trimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C=O", "C-Si"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C=C"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
